notes: Analyst: the whole pass-rate gap (+13 points) comes from one case (flags-sqli-secret-and-bugs). There the baseline found every defect but failed 4 format assertions (no per-comment anchoring, no weight labels, no separate short summary, not in line order). Those assertions test conventions the skill defines, so the gap shows the skill is followed, not that its review is more accurate.

Analyst: clean-pr-does-not-invent-blockers is non-discriminating, 6/6 for both. The baseline also approved with no blockers. This test does not yet show that the skill prevents invented issues. A harder clean PR, or one with a tempting but harmless pattern, would test that better.
Analyst: rewrites-harsh-comment is 5/6 for both and both fail the length assertion. The skill's rewrite is still about 6 sentences. The skill should be tougher about brevity in rewrites.
Analyst: the skill costs about 23% more tokens (+13k) and about 7 s more. That is the price of reading SKILL.md and the references.
Analyst: n = 1 run per configuration and the model graded its own run inline, so treat the numbers as indicative only. Voice and tone were not scored; a human should read the pairs.
